purpose: Define the lowest-cost executor qualification order and blocker handling so P1 can proceed without ad-hoc replanning.
global_rule: A blocked candidate is recorded and skipped. Qualification criteria are never weakened to force readiness.

strong_lane.goal: Obtain at least one S0-ready strong executor independently of the economic lane.

economic_lane.goal: Obtain at least one S0-ready economic, free, near-free, or local executor.

promotion_condition: At least one S0-ready strong executor and at least one S0-ready economic/free/local executor, each satisfying executor-screening-contract-v1.
next_action_after_promotion: Execute p1-minimal-execution-matrix-v1 as a pipeline smoke only; do not infer comparative treatment superiority.
scientific_boundary: Executor/provider unavailability is not evidence for or against the DV routing/escalation hypothesis.
